metric_definitions.definition: Mean cosine between each original French activation and French + m(alpha d).
Fraction classified French by a fixed-C L2 logistic probe fit only on training endpoints.
Mean French probability from the train-only language probe.
Mean reciprocal rank of the paired English activation among held-out English endpoints by cosine.
Correlation between original and steered within-French pairwise-cosine geometry.
Mean absolute change in within-French pairwise cosine geometry.
Shift norm divided by mean held-out French activation norm.
Shift orthogonal to the train mean English-to-French axis, divided by mean French activation norm.

protocol.direction_selection: decoder column and sign maximizing absolute cosine with the cfc_train mean English-to-French activation difference
protocol.intervention: French activation + strength × calibrated English-to-French vector
protocol.language_retention: train-only fixed-C L2 logistic regression probe
protocol.off_axis_drift: intervention component orthogonal to the cfc_train supervised mean English-to-French activation difference, normalized by mean held-out French activation norm
protocol.random_control: isotropic Gaussian direction independently matched to each learned calibrated-vector norm
protocol.scale: train least-squares scalar projected onto the selected decoder column
protocol.semantic_geometry_proxy: correlation and mean absolute change of within-French pairwise cosine geometry
protocol.semantic_pair_proxy: rank of the paired English activation among all held-out English activations under cosine similarity

semantic_scope: representation-level paired-retrieval and geometry proxies; no claim of generated-text semantic preservation

uncertainty.learned: population standard deviation across three trained seeds
uncertainty.matched_random: population standard deviation of the equal-weight mixture of 100 norm-matched directions per source model/seed cell
uncertainty.sample_level: descriptive held-out-example standard deviations are retained in the machine-readable tables but are not confidence intervals
